title: Nha Trang in 4 days
summary: Four days in Nha Trang. January to August. Hon Mun is a boat day. Hon Tre is a day on the island. Do not do both on one boat.

days.title: Day 1 — The beach
days.body: Arrive and stay on the sand.

days.title: Day 2 — One boat
days.body: Hon Mun is a boat day, or Hon Tre is a day on the island. Fees are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 3 — Po Nagar
days.body: Po Nagar is a morning. The adult ticket is 22,000 VND.

days.title: Day 4 — Long Son
days.body: Long Son is a daylight climb. The fee is Check on arrival.
